note: Reference comparisons document borrowed conventions and explicit non-goals.

references.borrowedConvention: Cell-level collaboration presence should show ownership without blocking nearby work.
references.note: Presence claims and short agent intent chips sit on cells as advisory state; final writes still use CAS.

references.borrowedConvention: Multiplayer cursors and object-level activity are visible but do not freeze the canvas.
references.note: Agent planning and commit leases are presence rows, while proposal cards appear only for meaning conflicts.

references.borrowedConvention: Triage collects work that must be accepted, assigned, or dismissed.
references.note: Noteworthy inbox, proposal chips, trace rows, and job cards keep next actions explicit.

references.borrowedConvention: Empty writing surfaces should invite capture without saving placeholder text.
references.note: Notebook ghost text appears only in the empty first paragraph and never persists to Convex.

references.borrowedConvention: Records need identity, source chips, and dense relationship context.
references.note: Company rows use initials, source chips, status, and evidence-bearing fields.

references.borrowedConvention: Chat and generated work product should be adjacent, with reviewable output state.
references.note: Copilot, Work Surface, Trace, and proposal chips keep chat, artifact, and proof connected.
